generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The tender/contract includes condenser tube cleaning by high pressure hydro jet and phosphor bronze bullet cleaning items on per tube basis as detailed in the schedule- B however, the agency has to quote Lumpsum basis (Total Amount). The L1 price bid will be evaluated and percentage variation shall be considered to derive the schedule-B item rates proportionately. Final derived schedule-B items rates shall be reference for payment.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The successful bidder shall furnish DD drawn in favor of General Manager (Finance) BTPS or Bank Guarantee obtained in the name of tender inviting authority towards performance guarantee / Security Deposit equivalent to 5% of the amount put to tender (estimated amt excluding GST) at the time of entering into contract agreement within 20 days from the date of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance of LOA/WO. The same shall be valid for the entire contract period plus 30 days from the date of end of Defect Liability Period

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder should have experience in the field of condenser tube cleaning by high pressure water jet method or spring loaded phosphor bronze bullet shot method or chemical cleaning of tubes separately or in combination in thermal power plants of capacity 210MW and above. The bidder should have satisfactorily completed as a prime contractor at least one similar nature of work of value not less than Rs 4.20 Lakhs (excluding GST) in the preceding five years, reckoned as on the last date of submission of bid. As a documental proof, the intending bidder shall furnish work order and satisfactory work done certificate/Performance certificate/MOM for the same work certified by competent authority (Scanned copy of original documents to be uploaded).
